## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 13, 2026 - Aug 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Leemiz_, Aug 22, 2026, 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            2. _Foody tracker_, Aug 15, 2026, 1/5: "Had this app for ages. Everything worked great then all off a sudden everything was behind a paywall and to scan my food I had to pay for the premium after using the app for years before."
            3. _Rhyssamuel06_, Aug 17, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve used this app for over 10 years to track my calories and it’s worked really well for me. Lately it seems more and more things are being locked behind the premium membership , some I can understand like the barcode scanner which is a real time saver , but lately they’ve changed meal macros to % instead of grams and then locked the option for grams behind the premium membership which I find completely ridiculous. The newer user interface is also far less intuitive than it used to be. Think it’s time for me to find another calorie counter"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 18, 2026 - Aug 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Verczeska_, Aug 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            2. _Jen,seeking resolution_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
            3. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->
